# Cost per arm — GPU-minutes and what they bought

*Generated by `pipeline/cost_report.py --per-arm --baseline sectors_v1` on 2026-08-25 from `Scripts/run_registry.csv`. DERIVED AND REGENERABLE — regenerate it, never hand-edit it.*

## Read this before reading a number

* **`gpu_step_min` is engine-subprocess wall-clock only.** It excludes VM setup, the repo clone and pip bootstrap, ortho staging, VERIFY reads and idle time between jobs. Colab bills **VM uptime**, so this is a LOWER BOUND on billable time — across the real launches, summed step-minutes cover 0%–100% of even the observed launch span (see `Reports/gpu_launches.csv`).
* **A blank `gpu_step_min` means UNKNOWN, not cheap.** 20 of 20 arms below have no timing coverage at all: their runs predate the 2026-08-25 registry cutover and carry their minutes as prose inside `notes`. Do not read those arms as free, and do not rank arms against each other on this column unless both say all rows timed.
* **Dollars are blank on purpose.** `pipeline/colab_rates.csv` ships with zero GPU rate rows because no Colab GPU rate has a source anywhere in this repo. A figure would be hearsay with a decimal point. The way to fill it is a MEASURED compute-unit delta across a launch, not a remembered number.
* **Honest metrics only** (CLAUDE.md rule 5): recall/precision below are the `live=1` independent numbers carried in the registry's inference rows — never held-out, never circular.

> **Baseline `sectors_v1` has no registry rows yet**, so no delta column is filled. Every figure below is absolute. Re-run this report once the baseline's runs are appended to the registry.

## Why every `est_usd` cell is blank

Dollars, when they exist, are apportioned to an arm from the LAUNCH that ran it (`--launches` → `Reports/gpu_launches.csv`), pro-rata by that arm's share of the launch's step-minutes. That apportionment would be INFERRED, never measured: a VM's uptime is not divisible by inspection. Today none of it runs, for these reasons:

* no launch status file mentions this (year, run_tag) — the runs predate per-launch status files, or ran outside the queue
* no rate row in colab_rates.csv matches 'NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB' (no sourced rate exists) — 8 launch(es): 20260822T155552Z, 20260822T160328Z, 20260822T172058Z, 20260822T173355Z, 20260822T175523Z, 20260822T175541Z, 20260822T193210Z, 20260822T200101Z

*Per-run dollar figures do not exist in this pipeline and never will — see the module docstring of `pipeline/cost_report.py`.*
